field_summary: The products subject to recall bear establishment number “EST. 12345” inside the USDA mark of inspection. Products were labeled as Kirkland Signature Ground Beef.
The products bear EST. P-45678. Items were sold under the Happy Belly and Signature Cafe labels.

WASHINGTON, Oct. 1, 2025 Ghiringhelli Brothers, a Vallejo, Calif. establishment, is recalling salads sold as Trader Joe's brand. The products bear establishment number "P-17156" inside the USDA mark of inspection.
